girls who play with Disney Princesses in the kindergarten classroom are able to animate the dolls and story lines to produce new and counternarrative identities.

the ways that children's play with artifacts and toys can be understood as literacy practice.

how young girls use Disney Princess toys and texts to produce identity texts and how they use identity texts as resources to animate, revise, and transform the meanings of Disney Princesses and their own gendered identities in the classroom.

the ways that children's literacy practices are shaped by and shape their social worlds, and with how children's play with artifacts and toys can be used as a window into the social and semiotic worlds in which they participate.
